text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ What a cute song! Love songs totally 
make your heart throb, don't they!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Totally get it~! It's so wonderful! It 
feels like the thrill of romance~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, right?! Just chasing after them 
might not be enough!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! From today on, Maya is gonna 
be a woman worth chasing after!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, let's go buy makeup! Maya wants 
to practice being a proper grown-up 
lady~!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But didn't Maya-chan say she had 
training after this?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine! That's all part of my 
romance tactic strategy☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Mayano Top Gun ended up neglecting 
her training...
